text:
Hello all, did anyone start the gradual process on a 52a visa? 
When my husband received his b1 visa the clerk told him to go to the immigration office and cancel his request for the 5a2 visa. 
Before he went to cancel his request (a few months after receiving the b1) he received an invitation to an interview about the 5a2 visa. He went to cancel his request and they told him it’s automatically cancelled and didn’t really know what to do. They also told him the interview was also canceled but didn’t supply any formal paper about that and he’s afraid to just not show up and suffer the consequences.
Any advice?
